title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. We introduce Lembas, a plug-and-play framework that formulates video RAG as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget. Our key insight is that the value of a token diminishes within each item and decreases further as similar evidence receives more tokens. Lembas captures both effects in a single objective and solves it with an efficient iterative water-filling algorithm that has a provable convergence guarantee. translated_title: 基于令牌分配的高效视频检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 高效的长视频理解需要在尽量减少视觉语言模型（VLM）所处理令牌数量的同时识别相关证据。现有的视频检索增强生成（RAG）方法依赖于帧选择和令牌压缩，但忽略了每增加一个令牌所带来的价值。我们提出了Lembas，一个即插即用的框架，它将视频RAG形式化为在共享预算下对帧和字幕进行令牌分配的优化问题。我们的关键洞察是：令牌的价值在每个条目内部呈递减趋势，并且随着相似证据获得更多令牌而进一步降低。Lembas在单一目标函数中同时捕捉这两种效应，并通过一种具有可证明收敛保证的高效迭代注水算法进行求解。对于多轮对话，Lembas复用此前轮次中已处理的令牌，并借助VLM的注意力以零额外开销的方式精细化相关性评估。我们的评估表明，Lembas提升了准确率……
tldr: Lembas是一个即插即用的视频RAG框架，将帧与字幕的令牌分配建模为收益递减的优化问题，用具有可证明收敛保证的迭代注水算法求解，并能在多轮对话中零开销地复用令牌。
en_tdlr: Lembas is a plug-and-play video RAG framework that formulates token allocation across frames and subtitles as a diminishing-returns optimization problem, solves it with a provably convergent iterative water-filling algorithm, and enables zero-cost token reuse in multi-turn conversations.
